user_story: As a user, I want to set a priority level on a task so that I know what to work on first.

positive.title: Set Priority Level on a Task
steps: Navigate to the task list page.
Select a task from the list.
Choose a priority level from the dropdown (e.g., High, Medium, Low).
positive.expected_result: The task's priority level is updated to the selected value and displayed correctly on the task list.

negative.title: Attempt to Set Priority without Selecting a Task
steps: Navigate to the task list page.
negative.expected_result: The system should prompt the user with a message to select a task before setting a priority. No priority level is set.

edge.title: Set Priority on a Task with Boundary Values
steps: Navigate to the task list page.
Select a task that is at the bottom of a long list.
Attempt to choose a priority level at boundary (empty input) or the lowest possible value.
edge.expected_result: The system should handle the boundary input gracefully, either by applying the lowest valid priority or by notifying the user of an invalid selection.
